Callout.Name: Explosives Cache Found
Callout.Message: Suspected explosives found in a lock-up.
Callout.Advisory: Lock-up standing open, nobody on scene.

Script.Line: It is a lock-up with the padlock cut off and nobody inside.
There are four crates and I have not touched one of them.
Do not put the cordon at the door. Put it at the fence.

Lines.Approach: It is standing open and there is no vehicle outside it. The team is twenty minutes behind me.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
